purpose: Permit an initial Phase A production decision for Admin/Operations and Shopper without allowing the Client portal to keep blocking the operational cutover.

deferredPersona.reason: Client portal is valuable but not required to begin live HR, visit, application and shopper operations. It remains a parallel release slice and cannot be represented as complete until separately validated.

criteria: live HR authority is dynamic
current and historical periods remain visible
visit identities are stable and deduplicated
no frozen visit count or month invariant
visits are listed from the canonical source
available visits and assigned visits are separated correctly
reservation or assignment mutations remain fail-closed unless their canonical write path is authorized
reload and new-tab context remain stable
applications list and application detail are usable
approval, rejection and standby controls are observable
no duplicate assignment is created
role and project scope remain effective
exact shopper identity is used
historical visits and certifications remain visible
available visits, own visits and profile are consistent
sensitive fields remain masked or permission-gated
three reloads and a new tab preserve context
KPIs reconcile with the same visit authority
current period is derived from live HR
no invented values or demo fallback in connected mode
delegated coordination model remains configured by project
royalty and income values are not invented
June settlement/payment status and prior paid history remain source-backed
payment execution remains outside this release unless separately authorized

releaseBlockingP0: Admin/Operations or Shopper cannot authenticate with an authorized identity
live HR authority is unavailable or materially inconsistent
critical data loss, corruption or cross-tenant leakage
Phase A operational flow cannot be completed
nonBlockingForInitialCutover: navigation highlight delay when route and view are valid
releaseDecisionRule: Initial production can be proposed only after the core Admin/Operations and Shopper slice passes source/static, unified read-only runtime, controlled in-platform scenario tests with exact cleanup, and human visual checkpoint. Client remains explicitly deferred and cannot silently broaden the release scope.
